title: AbRank: Antibody Affinity Ranking
subtitle: Sequence- and Lineage-Disjoint 3-State Antibody-Antigen Affinity Ranking Benchmark (v2)
description: AbRank v2 standardizes 20-AA sequence-complete antibody-antigen and single-domain nanobody (VHH) binding measurements across 24 public experimental sources under zero-leakage (<50% antigen identity, <80% antibody clonal-lineage identity) 3-state noise-buffered ranking ({-1: Depleted, 0: Neutral, +1: Improved}). Covers 4 Core Community Suites: AbRank-Maturation (22-cluster LOACO local L1-L3 edits), AbRank-Discovery (25 unfiltered continuous panels + VHH), AbRank-Generative (1,354 wet-lab generative AI designs), and AbRank-Transfer (Viral IC50, RBD Escape, ELISA, DDG, and AbAgym DMS), plus 851 wild-type 3D parental scaffolds. Code, curation & official evaluator: https://github.com/AI-SysBio/AbRank. Companion AbLang2 + ESM-2 LogiCA implementation: https://github.com/AI-SysBio/logica/tree/main/antibodies-abrank.
